title: SwitchBot makes a better fan
summary: The Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro adds native Matter support, more power, and a 70-hour battery. I was already a big fan of SwitchBot’s big circulator fan I recently reviewed, and now we’re getting the SwitchBot Battery Circulator Fan 2 Pro .
